Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: MihirBhavsar3102
Message:
Import digital-wallet sample app (unmodified)

Source:          https://github.com/tedrosdev/digital-wallet
Upstream commit: 011bd00b2e43aee3c9f955b4bd84b73ac40338b7
                 (master, "Refactor ui view", 2024-12-23)

Mapping (file contents are byte-for-byte upstream):
  backend/            -> app/backend/
  frontend/           -> app/frontend/
  docker-compose.yml  -> app/docker-compose.yml
  README.md           -> app/UPSTREAM_README.md

setup_env.sh is not imported. Every later commit in this repository
is a change made on top of this import.
